fields.title: Class column
fields.description: Pick the column that contains the class information.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: # Nearest neighbor
fields.description:
An option that determines how many nearest neighbors shall be considered. The algorithm picks an
object from the target class, randomly selects one of its neighbors and draws the new synthetic
example along the line between the sample and the neighbor.

fields.title: Oversampling rate
fields.description:
Specify how much synthetic data is introduced, e.g. a value of 2 will introduce two more portions
for each class (if there are 50 rows in the input table labeled as "A"; the output will contain 150
rows belonging to "A").

fields.title: Random seed
fields.description: The seed value for the random number generator.

fields.title: New
fields.description: Generate a random seed and set it in the Random seed input above for reproducible runs.
